## Overview

Angular Forms adapter for `[qzRadioGroup]`. Value: the checked radio's `qzRadio` value, or
`null` when none is checked (also what `reset()` writes). Touched fires when focus leaves the group.

- **Kind:** Directive
- **Source:** [packages/primitives/forms/src/radio-group-control.directive.ts:22](https://github.com/Andersseen/quartz/blob/main/packages/primitives/forms/src/radio-group-control.directive.ts#L22)
